items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Oh, he was with me in '43, maybe early '44.

ctx.x: When did Trummy Young work in your band?

Oh, he was with me in '43, maybe early '44. That was my second time back at the Park Central, and I had a complete mixed band then. I had -- I had five black people in the band with me there. I mean there was no token one

or two. This was just the way it was. I had Dick Vance, I had Trummy, I had Al Killian, I had Howard McGee and -- let's see, I had -- this trumpet player, I can never think of his name. I had it once and -- some years ago, and then I lost it again. But you talk about a band being loud, you know, this air conditioning wasn't in in those days, and they used to open the windows, and this was in the summertime, and we got complaints all the way from 5th Avenue.

items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: In fact, when I left Lunceford I went with Barnet for a while.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, she was with Barnet back there then. In fact, when I left Lunceford I went with Barnet for a while. I left Lunceford because he did too many one nighters. You know, it was really -- it would kill you almost, you know.
